scope: Corollary 11.7 (Strict folded tree) of the manuscript “Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups” (preprints/Virtual-compact-specialness-of-hyperbolic-one-relator-groups-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 258 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a6c45541e6943005), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 84. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The quotient b T is a tree with one L-orbit at each level, and every Zd maps onto a monotone line ℓd. Its row groups and slot maps have the conclusions of Lemmas 11.4 and 11.5 and Proposition 11.6. Stabilizers of finite monotone paths in any fixed height range inject jointly on first field homology into L, over path-orbit representatives.
